title.narrative: Extended comprehensive social protection for workers in all forms of employment

description.narrative: KSA has been experiencing a growing diversification in working arrangements, with a growth in new forms of employment, including through self-employment and the recently launched flexible work regulation. The share of migrant workers in the total employed population also remains high. The COVID-19 crisis has demonstrated the importance of ensuring employment-related social protection guarantees are extended to all workers, including migrant workers, especially workers in non-standard and new forms of employment. This helps preserve workers’ well-being and increase their productivity and income security. ILO standards provide a compass to guide these efforts. Within this context, the ILO proposes to provide technical support and capacity building to extend social security coverage to migrant workers and workers in new forms of employment (e.g. including part-time, temporary workers and contractors and the self-employed).
